newsitem.title: USA: Dog says "pasta", is "al dente" next?.
newsitem.headline: Dog says "pasta", is "al dente" next?.

text.p: A Cheektowaga, New York, pooch's uncanny ability to speak the word "pasta" on command has earned it top dog recognition in a national pet food manufacturer's contest.

Melbourne, an Australian Shepherd mix, beat out more than 150 competitors to win the competition sponsored by Thompson's Pasta Plus Pet Foods. The talking canine will be featured in the company's advertisements promoting its dry dog food.
Founder Richard Thompson said the company wanted to introduce its pasta product and inspire dog owners to teach their pets to ask for it by name.
Pet behaviourist Diane Arrington said all dogs possess a quality known as allelomimetic behaviour or "mimic" behaviour.
